The installer is failing because `caveman` requires Node.js >= 18 and you don't have a suitable `node` in your PATH.

Quick steps to fix:

- Check current Node: `node -v`
- If not installed (or version < 18), install via Homebrew:
  - `brew install node`
- Or install/manage with nvm:
  - `curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.39.5/install.sh | bash`
  - `export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"`
  - `[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"`
  - `nvm install 18`
  - `nvm use 18`
  - `nvm alias default 18`
- Verify: `node -v` (should be >= v18)
- Re-run the caveman installer:  
  `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuliusBrussee/caveman/main/install.sh | bash`

Note: activating a Python `venv` doesn't provide Node.js; you must install Node separately.

data.content: how do i now use cavemen to talk to you?

Short answer: say you want "caveman" mode and include the intensity. The agent will switch to the compressed caveman speaking style.

How to invoke it:
- Send a message that includes one of the triggers: "caveman mode", "use caveman", "talk like caveman", or prefix with a slash command like `/caveman`.
- Optionally specify an intensity: `lite`, `full` (default), `ultra`, `wenyan-lite`, `wenyan-full`, `wenyan-ultra`. Example: "Use caveman full" or `/caveman ultra`.
- You can also ask for help: `/caveman-help` to see the available modes.

Example prompts:
- "Use caveman full: summarize this file in 3 bullets."
- "/caveman lite — explain why my curl install failed."

Notes:
- Caveman compresses wording but preserves technical accuracy.
- If you want to stop caveman, say "stop caveman" or "normal mode".

- Line 1: mode trigger + optional intensity (e.g. "caveman full" or "/caveman ultra")
- Following lines: your normal question or content

Example you gave (works):
caveman mode
What are the differences between the various caveman intensities? What are the pros and cons?

Quick summary of intensities:
- lite: minimal compression — nearly normal wording, small token savings. Pros: very readable; Cons: modest token reduction.
- full (default): strong compression, terse but clear. Pros: good token savings, still technical; Cons: shorter sentences, less flourish.
- ultra: maximal compression, very terse (fragmented style). Pros: huge token savings; Cons: harder to read, may omit niceties.
- wenyan-* variants: same compression levels but with classical/poetic wording styles. Pros: stylistic novelty; Cons: unusual phrasing may be distracting.

If you want, try your example and I’ll respond in the requested caveman intensity.
